episodes.title: The Most Dangerous Black Cult in History Explained.
episodes.description:
In 1985, the U.S. government bombed its own citizens in Philadelphia, killing eleven people, five of them children. This is the true story of MOVE, the most dangerous Black cult in history, founded by John Africa, and the Osage Avenue bombing that destroyed an entire neighborhood. Discover how a radical cult, a desperate city, and a decision led to America's only government bombing of its own people in modern history.



#blackhistory#history#blackhistory#history












Disclamer: This video is for educational and historical awareness purposes only. It does not promote hate or violence of any kind.”
